veranderings.voor: soos die songod Ra en Anubis, die god van mummifisering
veranderings.na: soos Ra, die songod, en Anubis, die god van mummifisering
veranderings.rede: Puts both gods in the same name-then-description pattern, so 'die songod' cannot be read as describing both Ra and Anubis; the comma before 'en' closes the inserted phrase, it is not a list comma, and every protected word stays.
